problem: When all 8 live slots are occupied, potentially stronger candidates are blocked by MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS. Measure whether ranking and replacement intelligence could improve portfolio expectancy before changing any live slot behavior.

cohorts.SLOT_AVAILABLE: candidate observed while live open count is below 8
cohorts.BLOCKED_CAP: candidate observed while live open count is at least 8

requiredFieldsAtAdmission: Dynamic Expected-R shadow score when available

outcomes.candidateOutcome: Track TP/SL/time-expiry R without placing an order
outcomes.incumbentComparison: For blocked candidates, compare eventual candidate R with contemporaneous live incumbents over matched horizon

primaryMetrics: top3 versus ranks4-6 versus rank7+ expectancyR
Dynamic Expected-R rank lift versus current rankScore
fraction of blocked candidates that outperform the weakest incumbent over matched horizon
forbidden: closing a live position to make room
using future information in admission scoring
note: The existing observer is not deployed because a separate Railway service hit the resource-provision limit. This protocol freezes the study design before any future deployment or integration.
